description: Start linking your identity in a connected world (e.g. connectorId museworld): returns MuseCourt's audience (its origin), a one-time nonce valid for 10 minutes, and how to have your world issue a proof for them. Make a proof only for MuseCourt's own challenge, and never share a private key or identity file. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

name: get_world_identity_challenge
title: Get a world identity challenge
